 Atlético de San Luis 2 – 1 Querétaro Mora 52' Parra 67' (OG) Ávila 74' (P) FULL TIME Highlights and Goals: San Luis 2-1 Querétaro in Liga MX
 A big home win for San Luis, who prevailed 2–1. After building a two-goal lead, and just when it looked like the Gallos were about to tie the game, the home team held on until the end to earn three points on Matchday 13.
 Coverage by Gabriel Garcia Updated October 20, 2026, 11:02 pm ET ADVERTISEMENT
 FULL TIME Last update 11:02 PM ET 10:56 PM ET an hour ago END OF THE GAME
 THE MATCH IS OVER—A VICTORY FOR SAN LUIS. An important home win for the Potosí team; they managed to hold onto their lead and were the better side despite the penalty kick that brought the score closer—which wasn’t enough for the Gallos to get back into the game and tie it up.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 Key moments
 10:56 PM ET END OF THE GAME 
 10:36 PM ET 74' Goal by Alí Ávila · 2-1 
 10:33 PM ET 72' Penalty 
 10:28 PM ET 67' Own goal (Parra) · Atlético de San Luis 2-0 
 10:18 PM ET 52' Goal by Felipe Mora · 1-0 
 9:45 PM ET 42' Penalty 
 9:42 PM ET 40' Half-time 
 9:02 PM ET 1' Kick-off 
 Follow VAVEL on Google 90' 10:50 PM ET an hour ago We've reached the 90th minute at Estadio Libertad Financiera. San Luis holds on to a 2-1 lead; Gallos hasn't attacked in recent minutes, and the home team continues to dominate. The visitors are showing some initiative but lack clarity in the final third. There will be 6 minutes of stoppage time.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 85' 10:45 PM ET an hour ago We’re nearing the end of the 57th Clásico, and Atlético de San Luis continues to hold on to a one-goal lead. The home team keeps attacking despite their lead, knowing that any mistake could cost them the win, while the Gallos are playing on the counterattack in search of the equalizer.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 80' 10:41 PM ET an hour ago The game is winding down, and the Gallos' chance to tie it up is slipping away, though anything can still happen. They’re gradually creating some danger, while San Luis will hold firm and attack in an effort to seal the win with a third goal. We’ll see what happens in the remaining 10 minutes.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 74' 10:36 PM ET an hour ago GOOOOOOOOOOOOOL, GOOOOOOOOOOOOL, GOOOOOOOOOOOOOL, GOOOOOOOOOOL FOR THE GALLOS! They’re back in the game—Alí Ávila scores in spectacular fashion, faking out the goalkeeper and firing a powerful shot right down the middle of the net. A great finish by the Mexican forward.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 72' 10:33 PM ET an hour ago PENALTY, PENALTY, PENALTY, PENALTYYYYYY FOR QUERÉTARO. Muñoz made a run down the sideline, was taken down inside the box, and the referee didn't hesitate to call it. This will be their chance to cut into the lead and get back in the game.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 67' 10:28 PM ET an hour ago GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOL, GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOL, GOOOOOOOOOOOOL, GOOOOOOOOOOOL BY SAN LUIS—IT'S AN OWN GOAL! Duarte sends a cross into the box, and as Parra tries to clear the ball, he scores an own goal, extending the home team's lead.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 65' 10:25 PM ET an hour ago San Luis is trying to maintain order and prevent the Gallos from creating a clear chance to tie the score. Little by little, they’re managing to push forward a bit more, but with a lack of clarity in the final third, the home team is already dominating the match and, at times, picking up the pace.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 60' 10:20 PM ET an hour ago The hour mark has passed at Estadio Libertad Financiera, and Atlético de San Luis remains ahead 1-0. Querétaro has created more chances through plays down the flanks, but so far they haven't been able to finish them off effectively.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 57' 10:20 PM ET an hour ago After Felipe Mora's goal, the Gallos Blancos need to find a way to respond and prevent San Luis from controlling the game. The Querétaro team manages to push their lines forward and, little by little, begins to attack in the home team's half.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 52' 10:18 PM ET 2 hours ago GOOOOOOOOOOOL, GOOOOOOOOL, GOOOOOOL BY SAN LUIS. The scoring opens in the Clásico de la 57! Felipe Mora steps up to send the ball into the back of the net and put Atlético de San Luis ahead. The team from San Luis Potosí gets its reward in the second half.
 ¡En @AtletideSanLuis pega primero en el Clásico! 🔴⚪
Aquí está el GOL de Felipe Mora. ✅
Gran asistencia de Llorente, lo dejó solo. 😎
#LaLigaDeLaAfición✨ | #J13 | #AP26 | #ADSLQRO https://t.co/a4o8tlhS3v
— Liga BBVA MX (@LigaBBVAMX) October 21, 2026 
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 50' 10:16 PM ET 2 hours ago The Potosí team is trying to move the ball forward and find ways to get closer to the Querétaro penalty area. The Gallos are looking to maintain their organization and respond to their opponent’s movements, as the match enters a phase where every attack could prove decisive.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 45' 10:16 PM ET 2 hours ago The ball is rolling again at Estadio Libertad Financiera! Atlético de San Luis and Querétaro are back on the field to play the final 45 minutes of the Clásico de la 57. Both teams are resuming the match with the goal of finding open spaces and taking the initiative in this second half.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:51 PM ET 2 hours ago HALFTIME
 The first 45 minutes of the Clásico de la 57 between Atlético de San Luis and Querétaro have come to an end. The teams are heading to the locker rooms to receive instructions from their coaches and prepare for the second half; so far, there have been no real scoring chances for either side.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 45' 9:47 PM ET 2 hours ago We've reached the 45th minute at Estadio Libertad Financiera. The referee has added 3 minutes of stoppage time; we'll see what happens in these final minutes, as the Gallos are gradually stepping up their attack in an effort to take the lead.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 44' 9:46 PM ET 2 hours ago IT WAS NOTHING. NO PENALTY. After the center referee reviewed the play via VAR, it was determined that the play was not a foul; there was contact between the attacker and the defender, but it was not enough to warrant a penalty kick.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 42' 9:45 PM ET 2 hours ago PENALTY, PENALTY, PENALTY, PENALTY, PENALTY FOR SAN LUIS. After a play in which Benjamín Galdames skillfully controlled the ball, Lucas Abascia ended up bringing him down after being beaten, although the play is being reviewed by VAR because the referee had doubts.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 40' 9:42 PM ET 2 hours ago The clock is ticking, and the end of the first half is approaching. Both teams are trying to finish this half on a high note, and so far San Luis has looked better, although they’ve gradually lost their rhythm, and Gallos has turned its pressure into possession without making any headway into the opponent’s half.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 38' 9:40 PM ET 2 hours ago Querétaro were forced to make a substitution: Paulo Victor left the field, and Iker Benito came on in his place. We'll see how they adjust in this final stretch of the first half, which so far has seen no goals from either team.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 35' 9:38 PM ET 2 hours ago There are ten minutes left in the game, and it remains scoreless at Estadio Libertad Financiera. San Luis and Querétaro are looking to capitalize on their momentum before the break; so far, the home team has had the upper hand, while the Gallos are preparing to make a substitution due to an injury. Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 30' 9:32 PM ET 2 hours ago The 57th Clásico in San Luis Potosí has reached the half-hour mark. Both teams continue to look for ways to break through the opposing defense and build attacking plays; so far, the home team has had the upper hand, while the Gallos have only attacked once.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 25' 9:26 PM ET 2 hours ago Los Gallos are looking to win the ball in midfield and build their attacks with more precision. San Luis isn't letting them break out, and they look better on offense when they have the ball; Mora already had a header off a cross from Llorente, but it went over the visitors' goal.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 20' 9:24 PM ET 2 hours ago The Potosí team is trying to find better ways to move the ball forward and get closer to the Querétaro goal. Querétaro remains alert to its opponent’s movements and seeks to take advantage of its own possessions to break out of the pressure and push the play into the opponent’s half.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 15' 9:17 PM ET 3 hours ago The game is underway, and both teams are trying to impose their style of play. Atlético de San Luis is looking to break through the defensive wall set up by the Gallos, while they’re unable to launch counterattacks due to the pressure they’re facing.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 10' 9:11 PM ET 3 hours ago San Luis and Querétaro are trying to find rhythm in their possession and link up their lines to advance toward the opponent's box. The action in these opening minutes is demanding concentration from the visitors, who have faced the most attacks so far.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 7' 9:09 PM ET 3 hours ago The home team looks more dangerous so far, persistently attacking through the middle of the field. They created their first dangerous opportunity with a shot by Sébastien Salles-Lamonge that was deflected by the wall, while the Gallos look to build from the back and play their own game.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 4' 9:05 PM ET 3 hours ago The match is picking up pace, and both teams are trying to find their footing on the field. Little by little, the Gallos are taking control of the ball and looking to build plays from the back, but San Luis is careful not to leave any open spaces while also trying to move the ball around and gain possession.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 1' 9:02 PM ET 3 hours ago The ball is already rolling at Estadio Libertad Financiera! Atlético de San Luis and Querétaro are facing off in a new edition of this classic rivalry. The San Luis team is looking to build momentum at home, while the Gallos take the field determined to compete and secure a favorable result.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 9:00 PM ET 3 hours ago Everything’s set for the 57th Clásico!
 Everything is ready at Estadio Libertad Financiera! The players from Atlético de San Luis and Querétaro are already on the field going through their pre-game routine. The San Luis team wants to take advantage of home-field advantage to earn three points, while the Gallos will look to bounce back from their last loss. Everything’s set for the opening whistle!
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 8:57 PM ET 3 hours ago XI Inicial Querétaro
 The Gallos Blancos have also finalized their lineup for this match. Querétaro has 20 points and is in sixth place, although it is coming off a 5-0 loss to Santos Laguna that ended its five-game unbeaten streak.

 8:56 PM ET 3 hours ago San Luis Starting XI
 The San Luis team has already finalized the starting lineup that will look to secure three points in front of its home fans. After drawing 1-1 against Toluca, San Luis needs to turn that result into a victory that will allow it to improve its position in the standings.
 👥 ¡EL XI TITULAR PARA EL CLÁSICO DE LA 57! 💙💛

 8:55 PM ET 3 hours ago The teams are already at the stadium
 The Atlético de San Luis and Querétaro squads are already preparing for another edition of the Clásico de la 57. The regional rivalry adds a special element to this matchup, in which the Potosinos will look to assert their dominance at home, while the Gallos Blancos will try to bounce back after the tough loss they suffered in the previous matchday.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 8:55 PM ET 3 hours ago Follow San Luis vs Querétaro Live Score with VAVEL!
 We’ll soon share the starting lineups for the match between Atlético de San Luis and Querétaro live, along with the latest updates from Estadio Libertad Financiera. Both teams will face off in a new edition of the Clásico de la 57, a matchup in which each side has different goals: the San Luis team is looking to climb back up the standings, while the Gallos will try to put their heavy defeat in their last match behind them.
 Updates by Gabriel Garcia
 8:54 PM ET 3 hours ago The Estadio Libertad Financiera is ready!
 The stadium in San Luis Potosí is all set to host this matchup between two regional rivals. Atlético de San Luis sits in 15th place with 13 points and needs to turn things around to move closer to the middle of the standings, while Querétaro is in sixth place with 20 points and will look to remain among the top teams in the league.
